answer.rationale: Roll out simplified onboarding as the highest-confidence sustainable SMB response: it has confirmed improvements in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while prior signup simplification also durably improved SMB activation. Do not counter the competitor with promotional pricing: targeted discounts lifted acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, directly undermining the long-term qualified-revenue objective. Onboarding will not fully resolve price-driven churn among existing accounts, so its near-term churn-mitigation effect remains uncertain.
